lines: Part thirteen showed that coming back is not the same as knowing. Part fourteen asks a sharper question: how much evidence does a single bit cost?
第十三部说明，回到原处不等于回到同一份知识。第十四部追问一个更尖锐的问题：一个比特的答案，要付出多少证据？
One Fibonacci leaf word of eighty-nine leaves hides more than two million different trees. Confirming that the true one is the canonical tree takes at least twenty-one separate reads.
一个八十九片叶子的 Fibonacci 叶词里，藏着两百多万棵不同的树。要确认真实来源就是规范的那一棵，至少需要二十一次互不重叠的读取。
The Auric FIB atom pyramid, part fourteen: the ancestry cube and the cost of acquisition.
Auric FIB 原子金字塔，第十四部：祖先立方体与取得代价。
Local brackets, an orthogonal cube, and evidence that must be paid for.
局部括号、正交立方体，以及必须付出的证据。
The five patterns choose positions; the source tree says what was chosen. Take B, the third tree of the orbit, and D, the same three leaves bracketed the other way.
五种模式选择位置，原树则规定被选中的是什么来源。取轨道上的第三棵树 B，以及把同样三片叶子换一种括号方式得到的 D。
Both read beta, alpha, beta from left to right. Yet B unwinds three substitutions, and D cannot unwind even one. Its intrinsic depth is zero.
两者从左到右都读作 beta、alpha、beta。可是 B 能逆解三次替换，D 一次也不能，它的内在深度为零。
Why not? After one substitution, alpha only ever appears as the right leaf of a beta, alpha pair. A node whose left child is the single leaf alpha is proof that a tree is not an image.
为什么？一次替换之后，alpha 只会作为「beta、alpha」这一对的右叶出现。若某个节点的左孩子恰好是单叶 alpha，这就证明这棵树不是任何树的像。
Lean has frozen this local law for every one-step image. D carries the forbidden left alpha, so the difference lives in which two parts became one subtree first.
Lean 已为每一个一步像冻结了这条局部规律。D 恰好带着被禁止的左 alpha，所以差别不在叶数，也不在叶序，而在哪两部分先合成同一棵子树。
Inside the canonical tree T n, the copies of B sit at F n minus two positions that never overlap. Each one can be flipped to D on its own, and the leaf word never changes.
在规范树 T(n) 里，B 的副本出现在 F(n−2) 个互不重叠的位置上。每一处都可以单独翻成 D，而叶词始终不变。

At depth ten that is eighty-nine leaves, twenty-one positions, and two to the twenty-first, more than two million different source trees. The positions make up a fixed share of the leaves, one over phi cubed.
在深度十，就是八十九片叶子、二十一个位置，以及 2 的 21 次方、两百多万棵不同的来源树。这些位置占叶子数的比例趋于固定值：φ 立方的倒数。
With no defect the depth is n; with any defect at all it drops to zero. Depth is n times the product of one minus each defect bit.
没有缺陷时深度为 n；只要有任何一个缺陷，它就降为零。深度等于 n 乘以每个「1 减缺陷位」的乘积。
Expanded, that product has a nonzero top coefficient. Confirming the canonical source is the joint condition that every local position is clean; denying it needs just one counterexample.
把乘积展开，最高阶项的系数不为零。确认规范来源，是「所有局部位置都没有缺陷」这一共同条件；否定它，只需要一个反例。
Read each gap between neighbouring leaves at its lowest common ancestor, and multiply the leaf counts on the left and right. These ancestor areas always sum to M choose two.
在相邻两片叶子之间的每个间隙处，取它们的最近共同祖先，把左右两侧的叶数相乘。这些祖先面积之和恒为 M 选 2。

Flipping B to D turns the local pair one, two into two, one: one unit of area moves, and the total stays. Distinct positions move along orthogonal directions, so the family forms a cube with edges root two.
把 B 翻成 D，局部的一、二变成二、一：只转移一单位面积，总面积不变。不同位置沿彼此正交的方向移动，于是整个族构成一个边长为根号二的立方体。
Every quantity computed from the leaf word, its path areas and its moments, is identical across the cube. Only the ancestor areas see the difference.
凡是从叶词算出的量，包括路径面积与各阶矩，在整个立方体上都完全相同。只有祖先面积看得出差别。

Normalize by the total and the whole cube shrinks, with diameter of order M to the minus three halves, yet it still holds depth n and depth zero. Being close in geometry is not the same as being close in answer.
按总面积归一化后，整个立方体缩小，直径的量级是 M 的负二分之三次方，但其中依然同时含有深度 n 与深度零的来源。几何上接近，不等于答案接近。
Low-order statistics can agree completely. Spread one law evenly over the defect sets of even size, and another over the sets of odd size.
低阶统计可以完全一致。让一条律均匀分布在偶数个缺陷的子集上，另一条均匀分布在奇数个缺陷的子集上。
Every joint marginal on fewer than all positions is the same for both. Yet the expected depth is n over two to the K minus one for the even law and exactly zero for the odd law.
在少于全部位置上的每一个联合边缘，两者都相同。可是偶数律的期望深度是 n 除以 2 的 K−1 次方，奇数律恰好为零。
The native reader asks one address at a time and hears alpha, beta, branch or absent. B and D differ on exactly six addresses below their position, and nowhere else.
原生读者一次只问一个地址，得到 alpha、beta、分支或缺席。B 与 D 只在其所在位置下方的恰好六个地址上回复不同，别处完全一样。
These supports never overlap. Each new hit fixes one defect bit and cuts the cube to a face; the consistent sources number two to the K minus the supports already hit.
这些支持彼此不相交。每命中一个新支持，就确定一个缺陷位，把立方体切成一个面；相容来源的个数是 2 的「K 减已命中支持数」次方。
To confirm the canonical tree, every support must be hit, because each unread one still hides a consistent counterexample. At depth ten that is twenty-one reads for a single bit.
要确认规范树，每一个支持都必须命中，因为每个未读的位置都还藏着一个相容的反例。在深度十，这就是为一个比特付出二十一次读取。
Finding one defect proves depth zero at once. Over the full same-word fiber, the certificate size lies between twenty-one and thirty-four, and the endpoints are not yet shown equal.
而找到一个缺陷，就能立刻证明深度为零。在完整的同叶词纤维上，证书大小介于二十一与三十四之间，两个端点尚未证明相等。
Randomness does not avoid the unread positions. Put half the prior on the clean tree and half on single defects; with at most q supports checked, the best success is one half plus q over two K.
随机选择也绕不开未读的位置。让一半先验落在无缺陷树上，另一半均匀落在单缺陷树上；最多检查 q 个支持时，最佳成功率是二分之一加上 q 除以 2K。

So keeping every error below delta needs q at least one minus two delta times K. And a one-number summary, the total area shift, would decide depth, but the reader is never handed that number for free.
因此要让每个错误都低于 δ，至少需要 (1−2δ) 乘以 K 次检查。总面积偏移这样一个数就能决定深度，但读者从来不会免费得到这个数。
A coherent version of the leaf-word encoding does not help: matrix products are associative, so every tree in the cube compiles to the same operator, and no experiment can tell them apart.
把叶词编码改成相干执行也无济于事：矩阵乘法满足结合律，立方体里的每棵树都编译成同一个算符，任何实验都区分不了。
Only a genuinely stronger address oracle changes the cost. Then Grover's search finds a single defect among twenty-one positions in three iterations, with probability above ninety-nine percent.
只有真正更强的相干地址读口才会改变代价。那时 Grover 搜索在二十一个位置中寻找唯一缺陷，三次迭代即可，成功概率超过百分之九十九。
Reading never moves the true source along the cube. It only shrinks the set of sources that remain consistent with the record.
读取从不让真实来源沿着立方体移动，它只是让与记录相容的来源集合逐步缩小。
Under a uniform prior, after only clean answers with r positions unread, the chance of the canonical tree is two to the minus r. Probably right is not the same as holding a certificate.
在均匀先验下，若读到的全是无缺陷、还剩 r 个位置未读，规范树的概率是 2 的负 r 次方。大概率正确，不等于手握一张排除了全部反例的证书。
Every hidden relation here has its own evidence position. A short formula may decide the answer, but its inputs still have to be acquired, one support at a time.
这里的每一项隐藏关系，都有自己的证据位置。一个短公式也许能决定答案，但它的输入仍须一个支持一个支持地取得。

Lean has frozen the local law of one-step images. The defect family, the ancestor cube, the query bounds and the success formula are argued in the theory volume, and every number here was recomputed for this film.
Lean 已冻结一步像的局部规律。缺陷族、祖先立方体、查询下界与成功率公式在理论卷中论证，这里的每个数字都为这部片子重新计算过。
